command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$repo=$env:FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT
$evidence=Join-Path $repo "logs\remote-evidence"
Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo
& git fetch origin validate/native-preflight-selected-v3-20261005 --no-tags --prune
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "candidate fetch failed"}
$temp=Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ("native-filter-diag-"+$env:GITHUB_RUN_ID)
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $temp){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Recurse -Force}
try{
  & git worktree add --detach $temp 9bf3c86b16c53538ec74ba788156657ffa83fb2e
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "candidate worktree failed"}
  Set-Location -LiteralPath $temp

  $py=@(
    "tools\winui\run_checks.py",
    "tools\winui\resolve_validation_scope.py",
    "tests\winui\test_remote_windows_task_contract.py",
    "tests\winui\test_validation_scope_contract.py",
    "tests\winui\test_build_environment_contract.py"
  )
  & python -X utf8 tools\winui\check_python_static.py @py
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "changed Python static failed"}
  & python -X utf8 -m unittest tests.winui.test_remote_windows_task_contract tests.winui.test_validation_scope_contract tests.winui.test_build_environment_contract
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "infra contracts failed"}

  & git config user.name "flyExplorer validation"
  & git config user.email "validation@flyexplorer.invalid"
  Add-Content -LiteralPath "app\winui\m23_drag.cpp" -Value "`n#error FLYEXPLORER_EXPECTED_COMPILE_ERROR"
  & git add -- app\winui\m23_drag.cpp
  & git commit -m "test: local expected compile failure"
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "invalid compile commit failed"}
  $invalidSha=(& git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
  $invalidResult=Join-Path $evidence "expected-native-compile-result.json"
  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $invalidResult -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  $env:FLYEXPLORER_CHECK_RESULT_PATH=$invalidResult
  $oldPreference=$ErrorActionPreference
  $ErrorActionPreference="Continue"
  $failWatch=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
  & python -X utf8 tools\winui\run_checks.py native-compile --before 9bf3c86b16c53538ec74ba788156657ffa83fb2e --head $invalidSha --configuration Release
  $invalidCode=$LASTEXITCODE
  $failWatch.Stop()
  $ErrorActionPreference=$oldPreference
  Write-Host ("EXPECTED_NATIVE_COMPILE_FAILURE_SECONDS={0:N1}" -f $failWatch.Elapsed.TotalSeconds)
  if($invalidCode -eq 0){throw "expected compile failure was not detected"}
  if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $invalidResult -PathType Leaf)){throw "expected compile failure result missing"}
  $invalidPayload=Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 -LiteralPath $invalidResult | ConvertFrom-Json
  if(([string]$invalidPayload.failure_category) -ne "PRODUCT_BUILD_FAILURE"){throw "expected compile category was not preserved"}
  if(([string]$invalidPayload.stage) -ne "native-compile"){throw "expected compile stage was not preserved"}
  Write-Host "EXPECTED_NATIVE_COMPILE_FAILURE=PASS"
  Write-Host "EXPECTED_NATIVE_COMPILE_CATEGORY=PRODUCT_BUILD_FAILURE"

  & git reset --hard 9bf3c86b16c53538ec74ba788156657ffa83fb2e
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "candidate reset failed"}
  $greenResult=Join-Path $evidence "green-native-compile-result.json"
  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $greenResult -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  $env:FLYEXPLORER_CHECK_RESULT_PATH=$greenResult
  $greenWatch=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
  & python -X utf8 tools\winui\run_checks.py native-compile --before ef8e2d7a65c03c3727aae625facaf6305d7d9841 --head 9bf3c86b16c53538ec74ba788156657ffa83fb2e --configuration Release
  $greenCode=$LASTEXITCODE
  $greenWatch.Stop()
  Write-Host ("GREEN_NATIVE_COMPILE_SECONDS={0:N1}" -f $greenWatch.Elapsed.TotalSeconds)
  if($greenCode -ne 0){throw "green native compile failed"}
  Write-Host "FILTERED_NATIVE_COMPILE_DIAGNOSTIC=PASS"
} finally {
  Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo
  if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $temp){& git worktree remove --force $temp}
  & git worktree prune
}
